'''All Of The Jedi Sealed''' is a sealed league format on [[GEMP]] built from boosters of every Decipher expansion from [[Premiere]] to [[Reflections III]]. Its format definition uses the same set list as [[Open]].<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="lib" /> GEMP's sealed league type ''All Of The Jedi Sealed'' uses this format.<ref name="sealedtype" />

* '''Type:''' sealed deck (GEMP sealed league)
* '''Defined by:''' play.swccg.com format; league type from the Players Committee GEMP
* '''Card pool:''' boosters of all 15 Decipher booster sets plus random locations, 40-card decks
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''All Of The Jedi Sealed'' (<code>all_of_the_jedi_sealed</code>) on play.swccg.com; on the Players Committee GEMP the league type ''All of the Jedi Sealed'' is played under the generic [[Sealed]] format<ref name="pc-slt" />

== Card pool ==
Players build decks from the product their sealed league gives them. A league has two series; a player who joins gets the product of every series that has started, and every player gets each later series' product when it starts.<ref name="nsld" /><ref name="slp" />

On play.swccg.com the league issues:<ref name="slp" />
* '''Series 1:''' 2 Booster Packs each of Premiere, A New Hope, Hoth, Dagobah, Cloud City, Jabba's Palace, Special Edition, Endor, Death Star II, Tatooine, Coruscant, Theed Palace, Reflections, Reflections II and Reflections III (30 packs), 2 fixed cards (Dark Side ''Twi'lek Advisor'', Light Side ''The Signal''), and one random card from each of four location pools: Dark Side sites (14), Dark Side systems (15), Light Side sites (16) and Light Side systems (16).<ref name="slp" /><ref name="cardjson" />
* '''Series 2:''' 1 Booster Pack of each of the same 15 sets.<ref name="slp" />
The location lists are at [[GEMP sealed league products#All Of The Jedi Sealed|GEMP sealed league products]].

The format definition uses the same set list as Open, so the product limits the pool. It sets a deck size of 40 cards and marks the format as not a game hall format, so it is played through its league rather than at open tables.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="lib" />

=== Special rule ===
The GEMP format definitions list this special rule:<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="hall" />
* Once per game, a player may ▼ a unique battleground not already on table.

== History ==
The league type comes from the Players Committee GEMP code, where it is named ''All of the Jedi Sealed'' and played under the generic [[Sealed]] format; play.swccg.com gave it its own format.<ref name="pc-slt" /><ref name="slt" /><ref name="gemp" /> No source gives who designed it or when, and no league result in this format is recorded.
